content.text: Long ago, people lived in caves. They had no books and no letters. They drew pictures on the stone walls.
content.translation: 很久以前，人们住在山洞里。他们没有书，也没有文字，就在石壁上画画。

content.text: One child drew a sun, a fish and a star. Her friends looked and smiled. Now everyone could see her ideas.
content.translation: 一个孩子画了太阳、鱼和星星。伙伴们看了都笑起来。这下每个人都能看懂她的想法了。

content.text: Pictures came before words. They helped people remember and share their stories.
content.translation: 画比文字出现得更早。它帮人们记住故事，也把故事讲给别人听。

quiz.question: People drew pictures on the stone _____.

content.text: A boy found a golden path in an old library. The path was made of letters. Each letter glowed like a little star.
content.translation: 一个男孩在旧图书馆里发现了一条金色小路。小路是字母铺成的，每个字母都像小星星一样发光。

content.text: He walked on the path and met a story at every step. The letters told him about the sea, the moon and a brave cat.
content.translation: 他沿着小路走，每走一步就遇见一个故事。字母们给他讲大海、讲月亮，还讲一只勇敢的猫。

content.text: At the end, the last letter said: read me. So he opened a book, and the story began.
content.translation: 走到最后，最后一个字母说：读读我吧。于是他打开一本书，故事就开始了。

quiz.question: He opened a _____ and the story began.

content.text: Mia fell asleep on a soft white cloud. In her dream, the sky was full of stars and whales.
content.translation: 米娅在软软的白云上睡着了。梦里，天空里全是星星和鲸鱼。

content.text: She flew over a green hill and a little house. The sun smiled at her, and the wind said hello.
content.translation: 她飞过一座绿色的小山和一间小房子。太阳朝她笑，风也跟她打招呼。

content.text: When she woke up, her pillow was warm. Dreams are stories that our minds tell at night.
content.translation: 醒来时，她的枕头还暖暖的。梦，就是我们的脑子在夜里讲的故事。

quiz.question: In her dream, the sky was full of _____.
Dreams are stories our _____ tell at night.

content.text: A little astronaut flew past the moon and past Mars. A huge bright question mark shone in the sky.
content.translation: 小宇航员飞过月亮，又飞过火星。天上亮起一个巨大的问号。

content.text: She asked: why do stars shine? The stars said: because we are hot and very, very far away.
content.translation: 她问：星星为什么会发光？星星说：因为我们很热，又离你很远很远。

content.text: Questions are like little rockets. They take our minds to new places.
content.translation: 问题就像小火箭，把我们的脑袋送到新的地方。

quiz.question: The astronaut saw a bright _____ mark.

content.text: A golden egg sat in a nest of flowers. One morning it cracked, and a small green dragon came out.
content.translation: 花丛里放着一颗金色的蛋。一天早上，蛋裂开了，钻出一条绿色的小龙。

content.text: He looked at the stars and sneezed a tiny rainbow. All the colours danced in the air.
content.translation: 他望着星星，打了一个小喷嚏，喷出一道小彩虹。所有颜色都在空中跳舞。

content.text: The little dragon was not scary at all. He was only curious and kind, like every new friend.
content.translation: 小龙一点也不吓人。他只是好奇又友善，就像每一个新朋友。

quiz.question: A small green _____ came out of the egg.

content.text: There was once a small grey hill with no trees. One day a girl planted a seed and sang to it.
content.translation: 从前有一座光秃秃的小灰山。一天，一个女孩种下一颗种子，还唱歌给它听。

content.text: Rain came, the sun shone, and the seed grew. Soon the hill was green, and animals came to live there.
content.translation: 雨水来了，太阳出来了，种子长大了。不久小山变绿了，小动物们也搬来住。

content.text: A rainbow bent over the hill. Small hands can make big changes, one seed at a time.
content.translation: 一道彩虹弯弯地挂在山丘上。小小的一双手，一次种一颗种子，也能带来大大的改变。

quiz.question: The hill became _____ after the rain and sun.

content.text: High above the world lived a bright bird. Her wings were full of stars and her song was very soft.
content.translation: 在很高很高的天上，住着一只亮闪闪的鸟。她的翅膀上全是星星，歌声轻轻的。

content.text: Every night she flew across the sky and left a little light behind her. That is how the stars were born.
content.translation: 每天夜里，她飞过天空，身后留下一小点光。星星就是这样来的。

content.text: If you look up and listen, you may hear her. The sky is full of her quiet songs.
content.translation: 如果你抬头仔细听，也许能听见她。天空里到处都是她安静的歌。

quiz.question: The stars were born from her _____.

content.text: A boy in a brave red cape landed on a planet made of puzzle pieces. Every piece was a little door.
content.translation: 一个披红斗篷的男孩降落在一颗拼图星球上。每一块拼图都是一扇小门。

content.text: He solved the pieces one by one. Behind each door he found a friend who needed help.
content.translation: 他把拼图一块一块拼好。每扇门后面，都有一个需要帮助的朋友。

content.text: The last piece was the sky itself. When he put it in, the whole planet lit up.
content.translation: 最后一块拼图就是天空。他把它放进去，整颗星球都亮了起来。

Behind each door he found a _____.
